description: Presence simplification keeps the enclosing whole-rule obligation when that obligation rejects the input (engine §4.2).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X r | Y r
%rule r ($a:aa (cc ≻ dd) ≻ $b:bb) :: ∅
%conditions $a ∧ $.preceded-by(X)
%rule aa A
%rule bb C
%rule cc B
%rule dd B
